claim_ceiling: exploratory method and architecture evidence only

representation_policy.S: named scalar representation derived from the native model
representation_policy.M: named vector/modal/subspace representation derived from the native model
representation_policy.C: named interaction/coupling/system representation; never arbitrary feature concatenation
representation_policy.R: cross-representation relationship diagnostics; not automatically a chi component
representation_policy.U: uncertainty, residuals, conditioning, refusal, and nonidentifiability

families.name: normal_decoupled_baseline
families.native_truth: asymptotically stable, normal, uncoupled; eigenvalue stability is sufficient for the declared task
families.primary_task: classify asymptotic stability and detect whether extra architecture is needed
families.negative_requirement: must not manufacture conglomerate added value

families.name: same_spectrum_different_modal_geometry
families.invariant: eigenvalues are exactly {-1,-2} for every k
families.changed_structure: eigenvector geometry, non-normality, and transient response
families.primary_task: measure maximum finite-time two-norm gain on a fixed time grid
families.native_comparator_candidate: largest singular value of exp(A t)

families.name: same_modal_geometry_different_scalar_spectrum
families.invariant: canonical coordinate basis is the modal basis
families.primary_task: compare state norm at t=4 from x0=[1,0]

families.name: same_local_subsystems_different_coupling
families.primary_task: determine how system stability and finite-time response change while isolated local terms are fixed

families.name: feedback_compensation_vs_destabilization
families.known_hurwitz_condition: trace=-0.7<0 and determinant=-0.3+k*h>0, so stability requires k*h>0.3
families.primary_task: distinguish coupling-dependent recovery from absent, insufficient, and sign-reversed feedback
families.native_comparator_candidate: Hurwitz trace-determinant criterion and exact eigenvalue test

families.name: noise_entry_point
families.governing_object: stable linear stochastic state model plus observation model
families.primary_task: separate perturbations that alter the physical state from perturbations that alter only observation, and separately test sensor noise that enters feedback
families.native_comparator_candidate: known state/noise injection path and state covariance

families.name: nonnormal_transient_growth
families.primary_task: compare eigenvalue-only asymptotic stability with exact finite-time singular-value amplification

families.name: degenerate_subspace_refusal
families.native_truth: the full two-dimensional eigenspace is identifiable but individual eigenvectors are not uniquely defined
families.primary_task: refuse unique individual-mode identity and retain the invariant subspace

families.name: chi_nonapplicability_and_boundary_refusal

cases.label: restoring_second_order
cases.native_truth: licensed second-order factor with chi=1 and zero discriminant

cases.label: anti_restoring_second_order
cases.native_truth: saddle; discriminant cannot vanish for real gamma; critical-damping chi interpretation refused

cases.label: single_real_pole
cases.native_truth: single pole alone does not define the second-order chi coordinate

families.primary_task: demonstrate that chi admission and chi=1 boundary language can refuse mathematically invalid cases
